blocks.section: 7. Test #2: Pulse rate (bpm)
blocks.content: The  monitor  waveform  display  will  spike  and  stabilizes  at  a  higher modulation level.

blocks.section: 7. Test #2: Pulse rate (bpm)

blocks.section: 7. Test #2: Pulse rate (bpm)
blocks.content: Disconnect all equipments and turn off the monitor.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Press Power On/Off switch to turn monitor on.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Connect ECG leads to appropriate jacks on respiration simulator.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Connect ECG leads to MDEC ECG cable.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Connect MDEC to ECG input port on N5500.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Set simulator for respiration rate of 120 breaths per minute.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: After normal power-up sequence, verify the following monitor reactions:

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Monitor displays respiration rate of 120 ±3 breaths per minute.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Audible alarm will sound, 'High respiration rate limits violated' message will display and  respiration  rate  display  will  flash,  indicating  respiration  rate  is above default high alarm limits. (medium priority alarm)

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Decrease respiration rate setting on respiration simulator to 20 breaths per minute.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Verify monitor displays respiration rate of 20 ±3 breaths per minute.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.4 Respiration Operation with a Respiration Simulator
blocks.content: Note:  The  accuracy  of  N5500  ECG  measurements  is  ±3  breaths  per  minute. In the procedure  below,  add  the  tolerance  of  the  simulator  to  the  acceptable range of readings.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.5 Temperature Operation with a Temperature Simulator
blocks.content: 3.3.5.5 Temperature Operation with a Temperature Simulator

blocks.section: 3.3.5.5 Temperature Operation with a Temperature Simulator
blocks.content: Press Power On/Off switch to turn monitor on.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.5 Temperature Operation with a Temperature Simulator
blocks.content: connect temperature  probe  (supplied  with  the  temperature simulator) to appropriate connector on temperature simulator.

blocks.section: 3.3.5.5 Temperature Operation with a Temperature Simulator
blocks.content: Connect temperature probe to temperature input port on N5500.
